snippet.title: Gold Coast Gambits: Boca Raton & Palm Beach | Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
🎲 GOLD COAST GAMBITS: BOCA RATON & PALM BEACH

Gold Coast Gambits is a digital adaptation of our physical board game Boca Raton & Palm Beach — a fast-paced turn-based strategy game built around push-your-luck dice rolling, unique character abilities, tactical decisions, and two very different auction systems.

It is at its best with friends, but you can also play solo by taking on Gambits — individual challenges designed to teach the game and test your strategy — or set up custom matches against bots.

🎮 Play the free demo & wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4307400/Gold_Coast_Gambits_Boca_Raton__Palm_Beach/

The full game launches on Steam August 25.

🏝️ FROM PHYSICAL BOARD GAME TO DIGITAL GAME

My daughters and I have been developing the physical board game Boca Raton & Palm Beach for the past two years.

The digital version originally started as a way to teach and test the board game rules, but gradually became a game of its own. Today, development works both ways: ideas and improvements from the digital game find their way back into the physical game, and vice versa.

The artwork for the physical board game is 100% hand-drawn and created without generative AI.

👇 FOLLOW THE PHYSICAL BOARD GAME 👇
